Page 297 Cont.
Sep. 3 Hon Judge James Lynch of Pontiac - 82 - 3rd Stroke last Saturday ..... Geo. Erhart - 48 - wife phoned at 1:5 p.m. Matt. Furman - 72 -.... Feared ...... Cancer Mrs. Helen Hille - 39 - wants divorce ..
Page 298
Sep. 7th Mrs. Nellie Musial - 49 - nerves
8 John Masty - 28 - threatening stomach - tuomer, very thin. Enrolled To-day & promises more frequent Communion - has been not ... apprecia- tive in this ....
8 Julius J. Ostyn - 22 - married last May - T.B. threatened .... Enrolled To-day 1.00
Thanks ... for convers. - Frank Boillatst - raised without any positive religion by a presbiterian mother. After stroke and eleven weeks con- finement asked wife to get him a Cath. Priest. Was prayed for and En- rolled ... Having received Everything - Baptism - Communion etc. remark- ed "I feel like new person - lived 33 days.
Marsha Petyk - ten weeks hooping-cough and pneumonia
9 Nina Lousano - 16 - operation for appendicitis to-morrow Expected Daniel G. Beauchamp - 51 - operation expected to-morrow for gall trouble.
Florence Gonyeau - 53 - stroke recently quite helpless - has raised 12 children of her own and 7 besides .. ...
Jos. H. Bennett - 16 - Threatened T. B. - brilliant Mind.
Jos. H. Bennett Sr. - 48 - Double Hernia
Mrs. Prince - wants girl - housework - see other book.
Page 299 Sep. 10 10 Thanks - Rex Ryan - 12 - Given up as hopeless five weeks ago. Dr. Amos remarking, when boys mother objected to absolute helpless of science, "Well Dr. We'll pray to the God ... "O well if you want to pray it won't hurt anything; but I don't believe in that kind of'fall de roll" ... The boy is here To-day almost 100% OK. Deo Gr.
